---
mode: agent
description: Initialize today's LeetCode Problem of the Day.
---

1. Get today's Problem of the Day number by running from the solution root:

```
pwsh -NoProfile -File .github/skills/initproblem/get-potd.ps1
```

The last output line is the problem number.

2. Initialize this problem following the instructions in [SKILL.md](../skills/initproblem/SKILL.md) exactly, using the number from step 1.
